closedByA88.title: The one-shot clean-unpack runner piped nested child stdio and could deadlock when a retained test spawned its own Node process
closedByA88.closure: A88 clean-unpack uses a shell-free, self-reexecuting Python controller behind a minimal Node bridge. It runs at most five Node checks per process image, persists only bounded progress in a private OS-temp state file, then replaces itself with os.execve before the next group. Python subprocess.communicate drains stdout/stderr concurrently; a strict allowlisted module wrapper force-exits only after selected top-level retained tests finish module evaluation and flush output, preventing incidental handles from keeping the child alive. Per-command timeouts, byte budgets and ordered fail-fast verification preserve the exact 41-step sequence from a fresh archive.
